;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone]]
**The [[Turkish Armed Forces]] conduct their first joint patrol with the [[United States Armed Forces]] near the [[Syria|Syrian]] town of [[Tell Abyad]], within the context of the [[Northern Syria Buffer Zone|Northern Syria Buffer Zone agreement]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/turkey-us-begin-safe-zone-joint-patrols-north-65463437 (ABC News)]
**The [[Syrian government]] condemns the operation as a "flagrant violation of [[international law]]." [https://sana.sy/en/?p=172937 (SANA)]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] says the U.S. seems to be interested in a safe zone for "the terrorist organization", rather than for Turkey. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-syria-security-turkey-erdogan/turkey-cites-disagreements-with-u-s-even-as-joint-syria-patrols-begin-idUSKCN1VT0JI (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**Imports of U.S. goods into China decreased by 22% in August, while exports of Chinese goods into the U.S. fell 16% over the same year-to-year period, according to customs data. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/china-s-trade-u-s-shrinks-trump-tariff-war-worsens-n1051161 (NBC News)]
*A [[Aircraft_pilot#Airline|pilot]]s' [[strike action|strike]] over a pay dispute causes [[British Airways]] to cancel "the vast majority" of its 850 daily flights on Monday and Tuesday. It is the first pilots' strike action at the company since the 1970s. [https://gulfnews.com/business/aviation/british-airways-cancels-flights-1.66294153 (Bloomberg via ''Gulf News'')] 

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018–19 Australian bushfire season]]
**A [[wildfire]] destroys much of the [[Queensland Heritage Register]]-listed [[Binna Burra Cultural Landscape]] holiday resort, including its famous lodge, in [[Binna Burra]], [[Queensland]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-09-08/bushfire-destroys-binna-burra-lodge-gold-coast-hinterland/11489860 (ABC News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-australia-49629388/queensland-bushfire-engulfs-famous-lodge (BBC News)]
*A bus connecting [[Casablanca]] and [[Rissani]] fell off the Oued Damchan bridge in the Draa Tafilalet region, [[Morocco]], killing 24 people. [https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2019/09/282544/security-services-five-bodies-errachidia-bus-crash/ (Morocco World News)]

;International relations
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**[[Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (France)|French Minister of Europe and Foreign Affairs]] [[Jean-Yves Le Drian]] says that, under current conditions, the [[European Union]] would not grant the [[United Kingdom]] an extension beyond October 31 to negotiate its [[Brexit|exit from the Union]].  [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-france/france-says-eu-wont-approve-brexit-delay-as-things-stand-idUSKCN1VT094 (Reuters)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-08/french-minister-le-drian-sees-no-brexit-delay-as-things-stand (Bloomberg)] [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/sep/08/france-threatens-to-veto-further-brexit-extension (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Iran]]'s ''[[Adrian Darya 1]]'' oil tanker, which was temporarily detained in [[Gibraltar]] and sanctioned by the [[United States Department of Justice]], has sold its cargo after supposedly docking at the [[Syria]]n port of [[Tartus]], according to the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-iran-tanker/iranian-tanker-reaches-destination-oil-sold-ministry-tells-tv-idUSKCN1VT0H0 (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/08/british-iranian-relations-strained-as-oil-tanker-is-seen-off-syria (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Russian elections]]
**[[Russia]]n citizens head to polls to cast their votes [[2019 Russian elections|in elections]] for heads and council members of [[Federal subjects of Russia|federal subjects]], among which [[2019 Moscow City Duma election|an election for the Moscow City Duma]], [[Elections in Russia#Local_(self-government)_elections|members and heads of local legislatures]], and in by-elections to the [[State Duma]]. [https://tass.com/politics/1077127 (TASS)]
**[[Federal Service for Supervision of Communications, Information Technology and Mass Media|Roskomnadzor]], the state communications watchdog, states [[Google]] and [[Facebook]] published political advertising the day before and during the election, even though it requested them to [[election silence|ban such publication]] "in line with Russian law". The watchdog labels the tech giants' actions as "interference in Russia’s sovereign affairs". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-election-internet/russia-says-facebook-google-distributed-political-ads-on-election-day-idUSKCN1VT0K0 (Reuters)]
*The [[Parliament of Georgia]] appoints the previous [[Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia|Interior Minister]] [[Giorgi Gakharia]] as [[Prime Minister of Georgia|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.gulf-times.com/story/641078/Georgia-names-new-prime-minister-who-condemns-Russian-occupation (DPA via ''Gulf Times'')]
*[[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries|2020 U.S. Republican Party presidential primaries]]
**Former [[South Carolina]] [[United States House of Representatives|congressman]] and [[Governor of South Carolina|governor]] [[Mark Sanford]] announces a primary challenge against incumbent [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.axios.com/mark-sanford-primary-trump-bfa7c69c-d91a-4093-a39d-6cfcff496cb6.html (Axios)]
*[[Neo-Nazism in Germany|Neo-Nazi]] [[National Democratic Party of Germany]] (NPD) politician {{ill|Stefan Jagsch|de|Stefan Jagsch}} is elected as the mayor of Altenstadt-Waldsiedlung in [[Altenstadt, Hesse]], after running unopposed, prompting condemnations from Germany's political leaders, including [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|SPD]] General Secretary [[Lars Klingbeil]]. Norbert Szilasko, a member of the council who voted Jagsch into office says, "We voted for him due to the fact we have nobody else". [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/09/08/german-neo-nazi-elected-town-council-chief-support-mainstream/ (''The Telegraph'')]
